skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the organization of agricultural production and business management, including resource utilization, crop and livestock production, non-agricultural business activities, product marketing, financial management, distribution, accounting, and business analysis.
Apply knowledge to organize agricultural production and business activities, including crop and livestock production, non-agricultural business activities, and product marketing.
Manage financial operations in agricultural businesses, including distribution and accounting.
Organize marketing activities for agricultural products, including branding and geographical indication.
Conduct business analysis and research in agricultural businesses.
Develop self-learning and research skills to complete assigned tasks.
Deliver effective presentations and engage in group discussions.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
